public.view_imp_ca_ecl_config.name: view_imp_ca_ecl_config
public.view_imp_ca_ecl_config.definition: SELECT h.pkid AS ecl_model_id, h.effective_date, h.module, h.active_flag, d.stage_rule_id, d.pf_segment_id, d.pd_model_id, d.lgd_model_id, d.ead_model_id, d.overlay_rate, d.period_type, d.period_date, d.createdby FROM frs9_imp_ca_ecl_configh h JOIN frs9_imp_ca_ecl_configd d ON h.pkid = d.ecl_model_id

public.view_param_scenario_rules.name: view_param_scenario_rules
public.view_param_scenario_rules.definition: SELECT h.pkid AS rule_id, h.rule_name, h.rule_type, h.updated_table, h.updated_column, h.seq AS h_seq, h.value, h.active_flag, d.query_group, d.seq AS d_seq, d.table_name, d.column_name, d.data_type, d.operator, d.value1, d.value2, d.condition, d.detail_type, d.stage_from, d.stage_to FROM frs9_param_scenario_rulesh h JOIN frs9_param_scenario_rulesd d ON h.pkid = d.rule_id

public.view_param_segment_rules.name: view_param_segment_rules
public.view_param_segment_rules.definition: SELECT d.segment_id, h.group_segment, h.segment, h.sub_segment, h.segment_type, h.seq AS h_seq, h.active_flag, d.query_group, d.seq AS d_seq, d.table_name, d.column_name, d.data_type, d.operator, d.value1, d.value2, d.condition FROM frs9_param_segmenth h JOIN frs9_param_segmentd d ON h.pkid = d.segment_id

public.vw_frs9_first_default.name: vw_frs9_first_default
public.vw_frs9_first_default.definition: WITH cte_first_default AS ( SELECT frs9_default.prc_date, frs9_default.account_id, frs9_default.rule_id, frs9_default.os_at_default, frs9_default.eqv_at_default, frs9_default.eir_at_default, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY frs9_default.account_id, frs9_default.rule_id ORDER BY frs9_default.prc_date) AS rn FROM frs9_default ) SELECT prc_date, account_id, rule_id, os_at_default, eqv_at_default, eir_at_default FROM cte_first_default WHERE rn = 1

public.vw_frs9_imp_ca_ead_process_ead_cu.name: vw_frs9_imp_ca_ead_process_ead_curr
public.vw_frs9_imp_ca_ead_process_ead_cu.definition: SELECT prc_date, account_id, account_number, start_date, maturity_date, payment_start_date, stage, remaining_tenor, interest_rate, payment_code, interest_base, payment_term, payment_freq, next_sch_prin_date, int_pmt_term, int_pmt_freq, next_sch_int_date, grace_type, grace_start_date, grace_end_date, fib_flag, fib_start_date, fib_tenor, fib_amt, fix_principal_amt, fix_interest_amt, next_payment_date - payment_date AS idays, next_eom_payment_date AS eom_payment_date, next_payment_date AS payment_date, os_balance - fn_frs9_imp_ca_ead_process_principal_amt(next_payment_date, maturity_date, os_balance, grace_type::text, grace_end_date, payment_code::text, interest_base::text, interest_rate, installment, fix_principal_amt) AS os_balance, installment, fn_frs9_imp_ca_ead_process_principal_amt(next_payment_date, maturity_date, os_balance, grace_type::text, grace_end_date, payment_code::text, interest_base::text, interest_rate, installment, fix_principal_amt) AS principal, fn_frs9_imp_ca_ead_process_interest_amt(grace_type::text, next_payment_date, grace_end_date, payment_code::text, interest_base::text, os_balance, interest_rate, fix_interest_amt) AS interest FROM tmp_imp_ca_ead_curr m WHERE payment_date <= maturity_date AND os_balance > 0::numeric

public.vw_frs9_max_bucket.name: vw_frs9_max_bucket
public.vw_frs9_max_bucket.definition: SELECT a.bucket_group, max(b.bucket_id) AS bucket_id FROM frs9_param_bucketh a JOIN frs9_param_bucketd b ON a.pkid = b.pkid_header GROUP BY a.bucket_group, a.bucket_default

public.vw_frs9_movement_snapshot.name: vw_frs9_movement_snapshot
public.vw_frs9_movement_snapshot.definition: SELECT a.prc_date AS download_date, a.ecl_model_id, a.account_id, lower(a.group_segment::text) AS group_segment, lower( CASE WHEN b.account_id IS NULL THEN 'A'::text ELSE 'W'::text END) AS account_status, a.stage, lower(a.impaired_status::text) AS impaired_flag, COALESCE(a.exchange_rate, 1::double precision) AS exchange_rate, COALESCE(a.ecl_final_amt, 0::numeric)::double precision * COALESCE(a.exchange_rate, 1::double precision) AS ecl_amount, COALESCE(a.carrying_amt, 0::numeric)::double precision * COALESCE(a.exchange_rate, 1::double precision) AS gross_carrying_amount, a.restructure_flag, false AS poci_flag FROM frs9_master_account a LEFT JOIN frs9_master_account_wo b ON b.account_id = a.account_id AND b.prc_date = a.prc_date WHERE lower(a.account_status::text) = 'a'::text OR b.account_id IS NOT NULL
